title: BookingCancelled
description: A booking ended before the cargo was loaded. The load goes back to the board. Two paths send the same fields: either side cancelling (`by` is `shipper` or `carrier`) and an operator (`by` is `operator`).

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

reason.description: What the canceller wrote; empty when nothing was written.

driver_user_id.description: Null when no driver was assigned.

plan.description: The cancelled booking was a plan.

penalized.description: The cancellation counts against the driver's acceptance rate: a driver's cancellation of an instant haul, or of a plan later than goway-loads' free-cancel window before pickup. Always false for shipper and operator cancellations.
